write:switch-entries.summary:
The register /Users/acoerduek/Documents/workspace/cuopt-wt/gpu-presolve/design_summaries/gpu_mip_presolve/ASSUMPTIONS.md is brought up to HISTORY Entry 54 and commit f05d48e31 (the switches of milestone M1) and to the node campaign of Entry 52. It now holds 358 entries: 19 new (AS-340 to AS-358) and 27 changed. No other file was changed, and no git, build or cuopt command was run beyond `git show <ref>:<path>` to compare files.

What the update does:
- **Entries that now have a switch:** each has its Switch as the code of f05d48e31 has it, the other values that exist and those that are not valid, a new State, places under "At commit `f05d48e31`", and a sentence that begins "Measured with the switches of milestone M1" with its instance set (the 240 as local dumps on the Mac).
- **AS-338:** says what is closed (11 options with 17 other values, the counters, the tools) and which six choices remain without a switch, each with its reason.
- **Corrections, each marked "corrected on 2026-11-28":** the lead on roi5alpha10n8 in AS-027 and AS-339 (the integer pivot columns are on exactly 10 instances); the 12 differing models in AS-114 (10); and in AS-317 the design's sentence that the exchange needs only the bound ahead.
- **Campaign:** AS-259 and AS-333 carry the 6 and 11 failures of the node campaign with their seeds; AS-358 is the lost optimum at a bound of -3e19, counted apart.
- **Base-engine defect:** the implied-bound band times the growth limit (1.5e-4 outside a bound at the defaults) is its own entry, AS-353; AS-088 and AS-094 point to it.
- **Opening:** version line, the new "Added on 2026-11-28 from the switches of milestone M1 and the node campaign" paragraph, the per-section counts, the line-number rule for f05d48e31, and the new marker "no switch: not built".

How it was checked:
- All 21 engine, tool, check and test files I cite are byte-identical in f05d48e31, in 5611b07df, in the clean export and in the worktree as it stands now.
- Every Switch and every place I wrote was opened in that code.
- A script asserted that the 339 old entries keep their numbers, places and headings, that entries I did not change are identical line for line, that every entry has its eight fields, and that the overview has 358 rows in order with intact columns.

HISTORY Entry 54 did not exist when I started. I read it once it appeared and wrote the Set by lines from what it actually says; it has no message of the owner.

After my repairs the register is right and complete for the switches of milestone M1 (A) and for the node campaign (B), as far as this can be shown without a build: /Users/acoerduek/Documents/workspace/cuopt-wt/gpu-presolve/design_summaries/gpu_mip_presolve/ASSUMPTIONS.md now has 360 entries (21 new, AS-340 to AS-360; 36 changed). It was the only file I changed; no git beyond `git show`, no build, no cuopt command, no network.

The writer's work was mostly sound. What I checked and found right:
- Every code place cited by the new and changed entries, opened in the export of f05d48e31. The 23 files I compared are byte-identical in the worktree. Five line ranges were a few lines short.
- All 11 options with defaults, values and flags (presolve.hpp:228-318, choices_in_range 325-331, sub_rule_active 338-344, option_flags.hpp). No entry names implied_band_scale or a band above 8 as available.
- Every figure of the switch table, recomputed from the 41 stored summaries under gpu_presolve/results/bench240/s1c_m1_switches: the means over 237, changed and larger instances, fixed-point flags, rounds, counter sums, and what is left.
- The 18 campaign failures with seeds, profiles and option variants against the failure files, and the printed model of the lost optimum.

What was wrong or missing, all repaired:
- One unasked edit of old text (AS-027).
- "an owner's decision" in five State lines, which reads as a decision that exists.
- Test at the end without arm values in 11 entries that now have a switch; two still began "Needs the switch".
- Two items of the reports without an entry (now AS-359, AS-360), and the campaign as a whole missing from the entry on campaign size (AS-227).
- Seven older entries that still called the counters or tools scratch-only.

Not verifiable here: I did not rerun the models of the wrong results or the 502 tests; they stand on the reviewer's report, the tests in the repository and the session owner's rebuild.
